items.exampleEn: He confided his secret to only one person.
items.exampleZh: 他只把祕密告訴了一個人。

items.exampleEn: The two schools reached a mutually acceptable decision.
items.exampleZh: 兩所學校達成了雙方都能接受的決定。

items.exampleEn: Too many rules can alienate young members of a club.
items.exampleZh: 規定太多，可能會讓社團的年輕成員疏遠。

items.exampleEn: That old song always makes me feel sentimental.
items.exampleZh: 那首老歌總是讓我感到很感傷。

items.exampleEn: The two sisters have very different temperaments.
items.exampleZh: 那兩姊妹的性情非常不同。

items.exampleEn: The new park has brought vitality to the old neighborhood.
items.exampleZh: 新公園為這一帶老舊的街區帶來了活力。

items.exampleEn: The eccentric artist painted his whole house purple.
items.exampleZh: 那位古怪的藝術家把整棟房子漆成紫色。

items.exampleEn: Passengers grumbled about the long delay.
items.exampleZh: 乘客們對長時間誤點發牢騷。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is a bit eccentric; he wears a hat even indoors.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺有點古怪，連在室內都戴著帽子。

items.audioEn: She finally confided in her older sister about her problems at work.
items.audioZh: 她終於向姊姊吐露了工作上的煩惱。
items.questionZh: 她把工作上的煩惱告訴了誰？

items.sentenceEn: This deal must be mutually beneficial, or nobody will sign it.
items.sentenceZh: 這筆交易必須對雙方都有利，否則沒人會簽。

items.sentenceEn: He always grumbles about the weather, but he never moves away.
items.sentenceZh: 他老是抱怨天氣，卻從來不搬走。

items.stemEn: The street festival was full of color, music, and ____.
items.stemZh: 這場街頭節慶充滿了色彩、音樂和活力。

items.stemEn: His rude comments ____ many of his old friends.
items.stemZh: 他無禮的言論讓許多老朋友都疏遠了他。

items.passageEn: My aunt Rose is known in our family as an eccentric. She keeps seven cats, paints her front door a different color every year, and swims in the sea every morning, even in winter. Her vitality amazes everyone. She does have a strong temperament, and she sometimes grumbles when plans change. Yet she never alienates people. She has a maternal kindness toward every child she meets, and many of us confide in her when we have problems. She is also very sentimental and keeps every letter we have ever sent her. She and my mother have a mutually supportive friendship.
items.passageZh: 我的阿姨 Rose 在我們家是出了名的怪人。她養了七隻貓，每年把前門漆成不同的顏色，而且每天早上都去海裡游泳，連冬天也不例外。她的活力讓大家都很驚訝。她的脾氣確實很強，計畫一變動有時就會發牢騷。不過，她從不讓人想疏遠她。她對遇到的每個孩子都有一種母親般的慈愛，我們很多人有煩惱時也會向她傾訴。她也非常念舊，留著我們寄給她的每一封信。她和我媽媽之間是彼此扶持的友誼。

questions.questionZh: Rose 阿姨每天早上做什麼？
Rose 阿姨為什麼保留每一封信？
options: 她想寫一本關於家族的書

referenceEn: My dog has a gentle temperament.
My dog's temperament is very calm.
rubricZh: temperament 表示「性情、脾氣」（例如 a gentle temperament 等）

items.promptZh: 這枚舊戒指不值錢，但對奶奶來說有很深的情感意義。
referenceEn: This old ring is not worth much, but it has great sentimental value for Grandma.
The old ring isn't valuable, but my grandmother keeps it for sentimental reasons.
rubricZh: 「情感意義」用 sentimental，例如 sentimental value、for sentimental reasons 等
「不值錢」可寫，例如 not worth much、isn't valuable 等
「奶奶」可寫，例如 Grandma、my grandmother 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：acre、crumb、clan 與「精力與活力」語境無關，學習者一眼排除；acre 在本課 q13、q14 都出現，crumb 見 u07-l04
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: acre、crumb、clan 換成 u07 名詞 turmoil、deprivation、degradation；題幹改為 "The new coach brought energy and ____ to the tired team."，避免與 u10-l03 卡片 "Even at seventy…" 同句型

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：acre 同課重複；temperament、mutually、acre 與動詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: acre、mutually 換成 reassured、resented（及物動詞，放得進空格但語意不通），保留 temperament

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：跟讀 mutually beneficial for both 語意重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "This deal must be mutually beneficial, or nobody will sign it."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（情境句雷同）：改寫後的題幹 brought…vitality to 與單字卡 has brought vitality to 同句型

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查：新題幹 full of color, music, and turmoil 可能成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The eccentric artist painted his whole house purple.」示範第一義；釋義為「古怪的；怪人」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：sentimental 表示「念舊的、感傷的」（例如 for sentimental reasons、am sentimental about… 等）
